# crosswork_syslog_destination (Resource)

This resource can manage a syslog receiver for notification destinations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_syslog_destination" "example" {
  name     = "cwtest-syslog"
  address  = "192.0.2.1"
  port     = 1514
  protocol = "UDP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address or host name of the receiver. The controller resolves a host name once, when the receiver is created, and keeps the IP; the value you configure is kept as written and is not compared with the stored IP
- `name` (String) Name of the receiver

### Optional

- `certificate_id` (String) Id of the certificate of a TLS receiver
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `port` (Number) Port of the receiver
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
  - Default value: `514`
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol
  - Choices: `UDP`, `TLS`
  - Default value: `UDP`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_syslog_destination.example "<name>"
```
